d:
After the White Queen of the North moves her forces toward the southern continent, the Queen of Vilmoria dispatches a small elite unit to investigate this suspicious maneuver and prevent a looming conflict between kingdoms.

Led by Luneth, the warriors become known as the Fangs of Vilmoria — the kingdom’s sharpest edge, ready to strike before war begins.

During their journey, they will face not only enemies and political intrigue, but also their own inner urges and forbidden temptations.

Newer pages, sketches, comics insight and other comics as well, come first at my patreon> www.patreon.com/lizzardsama
